# papyrium.model.ibm_proprinter_ii

The IBM Proprinter II (4201-002), a 9-wire dot-matrix printer of 1986, for
Papyrium. It speaks the Proprinter's language through
`papyrium.language.proprinter`: draft, Fastfont at 12 cpi, NLQ made from
the draft characters, NLQ II, IBM character sets 1 and 2, and draft
download characters. `docs/ibm-proprinter-ii.md` records the behaviour
followed, from IBM's manuals.

**Its characters are stand-ins.** No Proprinter II ROM is at hand, so it
prints with the Star LC-10's characters: `lc10-draft` for draft,
`lc10-draft-elite` for Fastfont, `lc10-nlq-courier` for NLQ II, and the
LC-10's block graphics. The LC-10 emulates the Proprinter II in its IBM
mode, so its characters are of the same family, but they are not IBM's.
NLQ is the Proprinter's own, made by IBM's rule from whichever draft
characters are given.

## Demonstration page

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rob-smallshire/papyrium/master/docs/images/demo-ibm-proprinter-ii.png" alt="The ibm-proprinter-ii demonstration page" width="100%">

Print it yourself, as PNG and PDF, with `papyrium demo ibm-proprinter-ii`;
`-M` options set the printer up, such as `-M stationery=green-bar`.

Registered as `ibm-proprinter-ii` on the `papyrium.model` axis. The
options model the printer's switches and paper:

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `ignore-top-form-feed` | `no` | Ignore a form feed at the top of a form with nothing printed on it (switch 1) |
| `auto-line-feed` | `no` | Each carriage return also feeds a line, as `ESC 5 1` (switch 3) |
| `form-length` | `11` | Form length in inches (switch 4 gives 11 or 12) |
| `character-set-2` | `no` | Power on in character set 2, which prints codes 128-159 and the card suits, rather than set 1 (switch 5) |
| `auto-carriage-return` | `no` | A line feed, vertical tab or `ESC J` also returns the head (switch 6) |
| `paper-width` | `9.5`, or `8.5` for `sheet` | Paper width in inches, tear-off strips included; the line is centred on it |
| `top-offset` | `19/36` | Inches from the perforation to the top of the first line |
| `stationery` | `fanfold` | The paper: `fanfold` (plain, with tear-off strips), `sheet` (no strips), `green-bar`, `blue-bar`, `music-ruled` |
| `font` | `lc10-draft` | The draft characters, from which NLQ is made: a 9-row dot font's name or file |
| `fastfont` | `lc10-draft-elite` | The Fastfont characters, `ESC I 1`, in a ten-column cell: a 9-row dot font's name or file |
| `nlq-ii-font` | `lc10-nlq-courier` | The NLQ II characters, `ESC I 3`: an 18 x 24 dot font's name or file |

Not modelled yet: the proportional widths of IBM's table, which come from
the characters' dots instead; NLQ II download characters; double height;
the switch 2 choice between NLQ and NLQ II on the operator panel, which
has no panel here.
